notes: Closed-loop successor to the 15M: V7 Classic, Nevada 750, Breva 750, California from 2002, V11 CAT, Bellagio, California Vintage/Classic. Has a lambda sensor in the crossover, so a piggyback fuel module is trimmed back out by the closed loop below about 4000 rpm. Live local identifiers for this family have not been captured yet. Run the read-only identifier discovery scan and contribute the result; until then the workstation offers identification, DTCs and raw discovery only.

memory.write_blocked_reason: IAW15xWriter territory; no verified fixtures in this project.

routines.name: Throttle position reset
routines.description: 15RC throttle reset. GuzziDiag uses a family-specific byte (0x89) rather than the 5AM sequence, so this entry is unproven on the wire.
routines.warning: Do NOT reset the TPS electronically on a California 1100 or Bellagio - those must be set manually with a voltmeter. Target angle for V7 Classic / Nevada / Breva 750 is about 3.6 degrees.
routines.follow_up: Confirm the throttle angle against the model target, then re-check idle.

routines.name: CO trim
routines.description: Adjusts the base mixture trim. Only meaningful with the lambda loop switched off.
routines.warning: Changing CO trim with the lambda loop active achieves nothing - the ECU trims it straight back out.
